Proprietary versions include the Seastar and MOSES mini TLPs; relatively low cost, used in water depths between 180 and 1,300 metres (590 and 4,270 ft)

Types of offshore oil and gas structures: Vertically moored tension leg and mini-tension leg platform; TLPs tethered to seabed eliminating most vertical movement, used in water depths up to about 2,000 m
